comment: Pinned ProotX support release. ProotX downloads exactly these assets and verifies every SHA-256 before use. Never replace a published asset; corrections require a new release.

lanes.common: architecture-neutral non-native scripts/data; packaged as APK assets and installed into filesDir/support
lanes.legacy: API 21-28 native payload; packaged as APK assets and extracted into filesDir/support only on API <= 28
lanes.modern: API 29+ native payload; packaged under jniLibs/<abi> and executed from nativeLibraryDir only
